advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a DC backend test that builds `JiraDataCenterBackend(client=<fake with search_users>)` WITHOUT replacing `backend.outbound`, and asserts `backend.outbound.resolve_assignee(name, remote_identity)` resolves authoritatively via the constructor-bound `_search_users_by_username` closure.
evidence: test body: `backend = JiraDataCenterBackend(transport=FakeTransport(), client=object())` then `backend.outbound = type(backend.outbound)(assignee_resolver=_resolver(("ada.l", True, False)))` — the constructor-built outbound is thrown away and replaced

backend.py:344-350: `self.outbound = _DCOutbound(assignee_resolver=((lambda name: _search_users_by_username(client, name)) if client is not None else None))` — this conditional binding is the changed line under review

ABSENCE: search for `search_users` across tests/unit/rebar_reconciler shows only transport-level tests (test_dc_unassign_751e.py, test_transport_port_completeness_heldout.py); none construct a DC backend with a real client and resolve an assignee authoritatively through `backend.outbound.resolve_assignee` using the constructor-bound resolver
advisory.finding: The DC backend constructor's client-backed resolver wiring (the line the diff changed at backend.py:344-350, which binds `_search_users_by_username(client, name)` onto `_DCOutbound` when `client is not None`) is never exercised by any test. `test_data_center_uses_its_constructor_supplied_resolver` builds a backend with `client=object()` but immediately discards the constructor-wired `backend.outbound`, replacing it with a hand-rolled `_DCOutbound(assignee_resolver=_resolver(...))`, so the constructor's `client is not None` conditional and the `_search_users_by_username` closure go untested. This is regression-blind to the exact defect class the ticket cites (PR #120's dead authoritative branch).
scenarios: A future change that mis-wires the constructor conditional (e.g. binding None even when client is present, reintroducing PR #120's dead-branch defect) would not be caught
A change to `_search_users_by_username`'s signature or the closure arity would pass this suite
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_data_center_uses_its_constructor_supplied_resolver, use a fake client whose `search_users` returns a matching user and assert directly on `backend.outbound.resolve_assignee("ada", None)` returning an authoritative tuple — do not reassign `backend.outbound`.
